plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, the 4-date timeline completes: 21 Jan 1911 (Peyton Rous filters the first cancer-causing retrovirus, RSV, waiting 55 years for his 1966 Nobel Prize) · Apr 1971 & Oct 1986 (Alfred Knudson publishes the Two-Hit retinoblastoma equation proving recessive tumour-suppressor brakes; Weinberg & Dryja clone RB1) · 11 Mar 1976 (Stehelin, Varmus, Bishop & Vogt prove viral src is a stolen normal cellular proto-oncogene c-src, winning the 1989 Nobel Prize) · May 1979, Apr 1989 & Oct 2015 (Lane, Crawford, Levine & Old discover p53, Vogelstein proves TP53 is the master tumour suppressor mutated in >50% of cancers, and Schiffman & Lynch show elephants carry 20 copies / 40 alleles of TP53).
